text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following the checkup results, K.S. 
Miracle was cleared to race in earnest. It 
seemed her Trainer's devoted support had 
borne fruit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
According to her parents, K.S. Miracle had 
always been a selfless, undemanding child. 
Yet, there was just one wish that young 
child once let slip.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"I want to be able to run"— To make that 
dream come true, the Trainer sets their 
sights on the Aoi Stakes.
